text.p: ** BIRTHDAYS **
English explorer DANIEL THOMPSON who charted large areas of Canada was born in 1770.

HITLER'S Foreign Minister JOACHIM VON RIBBENTROP was born in 1893. He major contribution to the Nazis was the non-aggression Pact in 1939, which stopped Russian intervention when Germany invaded Poland. He was hanged after the war as a war criminal.
FRANZ LEHAR , who composed "The Merry Widow", was born in 1870.
Long time Liberal Party director TONY EGGLETON was born in England in 1932.

American King Of The Outlaw Country Movement WILLIE NELSON was born in 1933. He had his first records in the Country and Western charts in 1962. He has had more than 100 entries. His biggest pop hit was "Always On My Mind" (1982). He also had hits with duets ... with JULIO IGLESIAS "To All The Girls I've Loved
American actress JILL CLAYBURGH was born in 1944. She was nominated for an Oscar in the film "An Unmarried Woman".
** EVENTS **
1789 : GEORGE WASHINGTON took the oath of office, and
officially became the United State's first President.

Australian Rugby League star MICHAEL CLEARY was born in 1940. He left football for politics in the NSW parliament with the Labor Party.

US singer BOBBY VEE was born in 1943. He formed the 'Shadows' in 1959. Hits included "Take Good Care Of My Baby" (1961), "Run To Him" (1961), "The Night Has A Thousand Eyes" (1962) and "Come Back When You Grow Up" (1967).
1900 : American railway legend "CASEY" JONES died in a

rail accident. JONES was trying to deliver mail that was eight hours late, when his train the Cannonball Express, clipped the rear carriage of another train parked at a siding. Jones' train derailed, and he was the only fatality.
1945 : ADOLF HITLER commited suicide. Hours before he'd

assisted his mistress EVA BRAUN to kill herself. He bid farewell to his remaining aides, retired to his room in his Berlin bunker and shot himself. His aides burned his body so it couldn't be found by the advancing Russians.
1967 : MUHAMMAD ALI was stripped of his world heavyweight

title, for refusing to be conscripted into the American army. ALI opposed conscription and refused to join up because of his religious beliefs. The American based "international" boxing authorities stripped him of his title, and banned him from boxing. He later won an appeal against the ban.
1975 : The Vietnam War ended with the fall of Saigon.
1987 : In London the Law Lords approved the sterilisation
of a 17-year-old mentally retarded girl.
1992 : Mutinous soldiers in Sierra Leone overthrew
President JOSEPH MOMOH in a coup.
